extraction_notes: Identity verified from the supplied PDF: PXT8050, ANHUI FOSAN SEMICONDUCTOR TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD., NPN power amplifier, SOT-89 package. Exact task identity is LCSC C20628878.
The PDF has four pages and does not state a revision. Electrical characteristics are specified at TA=25 degC unless otherwise noted.

Maximum ratings on p. 1 include VCBO=40 V, VCEO=25 V, VEBO=5 V, IC=1.5 A, PC=0.5 W at TA=25 degC, RthetaJA=250 degC/W, and TJ/Tstg=-55 to +150 degC. Only VCEO is represented in the schema specs object.

The electrical-characteristics table gives guaranteed HFE bounds of 85 minimum and 400 maximum at IC=100 mA and VCE=1 V, and 40 minimum at IC=800 mA and VCE=1 V. The table gives VCE(sat) maximum 0.5 V and VBE(sat) maximum 1.2 V at IC=800 mA and IB=80 mA. Guaranteed bounds were not converted to typical values.

The electrical-characteristics table gives fT minimum 100 MHz at VCE=10 V and IC=50 mA, and Cob typical 13 pF at VCB=10 V, IE=0, and f=1 MHz. No Cib electrical-characteristics table row is published, so cibo is null.

Curves on p. 3 were manually digitized from visible plotted lines at labelled or major-grid positions. Values are direct plot read-offs in SI units; no interpolation was used. The hFE plot provides separate TA=25 degC and TA=100 degC curves at VCE=1 V. The VCE(sat) and VBE(sat) plots provide separate curves at beta=10 for TA=25 degC and TA=100 degC. The fT plot is at VCE=10 V and TA=25 degC. The capacitance plot is at f=1 MHz and TA=25 degC, with IE=0 for Ccb and IC=0 for Cib.

The static-characteristic plot is present on p. 3 but is omitted because the multiple IB curves and raster resolution do not provide sufficiently reproducible numeric points without unsupported interpolation. The PC-versus-TA plot is omitted because it is thermal/package evidence rather than an electrical BJT curve represented by this schema.
The supplied archetype sets the fidelity ceiling for a bipolar junction transistor extraction at F2; this JSON contains datasheet facts and curve evidence only, not a fitted SPICE model.
